title: Experimental Evaluation of a Checklist-Based Inspection Technique to Verify the Compliance of Software Systems with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law
reasoning: The paper evaluates a technique to ensure software systems comply with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD). This law is a legal framework that establishes principles for processing personal data, including 'non-discrimination' and 'accountability,' and aims to ensure data is used 'ethically' and safeguarded. The core subject matter directly deals with ethical and moral considerations of data privacy and protection in software.
